title: medicago doliata var. muricata
intro: Medicago doliata var. muricata, commonly known as the Spurred Medic, is a perennial legume plant native to the Mediterranean region. The Spurred Medic is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Medicago doliata var. muricata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of the Spurred Medic include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
